technique_name: Compare and contrast the use of metaphors in two different books.
description: The use of metaphors in "The Catcher in the Rye" by J.D. Salinger and "The Great Gatsby" by F. Scott Fitzgerald differ greatly. In "The Catcher in the Rye," metaphors serve as a way for Holden Caulfield to better express his ideas, as well as his thoughts on humanity. He often uses metaphors to draw comparisons between his life and others' - for instance, he compares himself to a "catcher in the rye" who is guarding children from falling off a cliff.
